1921 Western Australian state election.question: Of these, 3 were held by Labor, 2 by the _____ and 1 was held by the National Labor Party
1921 Western Australian state election.fact: The incumbent government, led by Premier James Mitchell of the Nationalist Party and supported by the Country Party and National Labor Party, won a second term in government against the Labor Party opposition, led by Opposition Leader Philip Collier. Of these, 3 were held by Labor, 2 by the Country Party and 1 was held by the National Labor Party.
